nodes.description: Public token symbol string, set once in the Futurescoin constructor.
Public token name string, set once in the Futurescoin constructor.
Public decimals value (10) set in the constructor.
_totalSupply: 1000000000000000000 units minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address=>uint) balances holding token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
owner address of the Owned contract, checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner pending-transfer address used by transferOwnership / acceptOwnership two-step handover.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for balance indexing, allowance writes and ownership checks.
Constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves tokens via allowance, decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve(address,uint): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
allowance(address,address): returns remaining allowance from the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then invokes the spender contract's receiveApproval callback, enabling reentrancy.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner].
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and zeroes newOwner.
onlyOwner transferOwnership(address): stages a new owner in newOwner.
SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with overflow require check used by transfer/transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a); c = a - b, used for all balance/allowance decrements.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplication with overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: division with require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance write in approveAndCall; classic reentrancy sink.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address in transferAnyERC20Token.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(): destination address of the token transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(): amount subtracted from msg.sender and added to 'to'.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(): source account whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(): destination account credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(): amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(): key of the allowed mapping entry being set.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(): allowance value written to allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(): both allowance key and target contract of the callback.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(): allowance value and callback argument.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(): arbitrary bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(): attacker-influenced external contract target.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token(): amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership(): address staged into newOwner.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd(): first addend.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd(): second addend, checked for overflow.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf(): lookup key for the balances mapping.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance(): outer key of the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(): inner key of the allowed mapping.
